files.init/rc.board_sensors:
#!/bin/sh
#
# PX4 FMUv6C specific board sensors init
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
board_adc start

# Internal SPI Bus 1 ICM45686p ROTATION_ROLL_180_YAW_90
icm45686 -b 1 -s -R 2 start
#icm45686 -b 1 -s -R 2 -f 25 start

# 以(100kHz) 啟動 BMP388
#bmp388 start -I -b 1 -f 100000
bmp388 start -I -b 1

# 以(100kHz) 啟動 iis2mdc  ROTATION_YAW_270
#iis2mdc start -I -b 1 -R 6 -f 100000
iis2mdc start -I -b 1 -R 6
